title: Diwali Mega Buffet & Bazaar

long_description:
Saturday, October 24 | 11 AM – 2:30 PM | Raag's grand Diwali buffet + free festive bazaar

About this Event

Join our BIGGEST buffet spread since opening. 50th & France, EAAA & Raag are turning this district into a big celebration of food, culture and community over 3 days. Come with the family, dress festive and arrive hungry.

Grand Diwali Buffet with favorites from across India, American classics, plenty of vegetarian choices, sweets, gluten-free, dairy-free, vegan choices & more — including Samosa, Dahi Vada, Paani Poori Fountain, Chana Bhatura, Chocolate Fountain, Gajar Halwa, Sooji Halwa, Gujarati peanut Dal, fresh in-house Namkeen, paneer dishes, makhana, soya matar keema (vegan), Bombay sandwich, grilled fish, chicken and so much more.

Between plates, wander through our FREE Bazaar featuring local vendors with jewelry, LIVE henna, Indian clothing, home décor and festive finds.

Saturday, October 24 | 11 AM – 2:30 PM.

Tickets: Adult $37 | Kids $19
